in_greek.name: Γερμανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Γερμανός προέρχεται από την αρχαία Γερμανία και σημαίνει 'γνήσιος από Γερμανία' ή 'αληθινός Γερμανός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο όρος χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει ανθρώπους από τη Γερμανία.

in_latin.name: Germain
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Germain originem habet in Germania, et significat 'Germanus' vel 'sanctus Germanus'. In ecclesia primitiva, nomen hoc ad personas sanctas et nobiles referebatur.

in_english.name: Germain
in_english.meaning: From Germany, a Christian name with noble connotations
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Germain originates from the country of Germany, carrying connotations of nobility and sanctity. Etymologically derived from the Latin 'Germanus,' meaning 'brother' or 'from Germany,' the name has been used in various Christian traditions to signify a connection to the Germanic peoples or to denote a person of noble character. Historically, the name has been associated with several saints, including Saint Germain of Paris, a 6th-century bishop and theologian. In modern usage, the name Germain remains popular across Christian cultures, symbolizing a rich heritage of faith and tradition.
